name: middleleap-loom-demo
description: The Loom demo institution — Meridian Trust, a fictional CBUAE-regulated bank, packaged as an institution pack: its brand guidelines (palette, type, slide layout, logos) and its capital-approval business case (ISB pre-screening, CIC detailed case, NPV model, sign-offs). Shows how an institution's own context plugs into the Loom's discovery → delivery gate; retarget it to a real bank by swapping the values.
